topic: Hashrate as a mining lottery ticket
title: Why Hashrate Is Just a Mining Lottery Ticket
hook: Think of your hashrate as a lottery ticket.

scenes.narration: Your chance of finding a block equals your share of total network hashrate.
Hold twice the share and you hold twice the chance. It is still chance.
Pools split rewards by work contributed, so payouts arrive smaller and more often.

cta: How many tickets do you hold? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Your chance of finding a block is your share of network hashrate, and pools smooth the luck.
